canonical_journey_name: Form and Commit a Governed Case
starting_state: An operator or external actor has supported intent, a versioned template, an external plan proposal, a methodology or topology, a specification pipeline, or a bounded Thoth proposal.
preconditions: available environment, evaluator, endpoint, sandbox, retention, and execution-limit declarations where required.
intention: Turn intent, a template, or an untrusted proposal into a validated, previewed, immutable case plan.
job: Choose the appropriate work source, declare dependencies and criteria, inspect the complete proposal, and commit it before execution side effects.
authority_requirements: Attributable actor context and role resolution
Policy digest binding against active snapshot
expected_consequential_state_transitions: Intent, template, or untrusted proposal becomes a draft `CasePlan`
preflighted plan becomes an immutable committed case
stale input returns to fresh preflight rather than direct commit.
settlement_condition: The exact accepted plan, parameters, criteria, provenance, configuration digests, and model references are committed before any execution side effect.
expected_next_decisions_and_affordances: revise or abandon an invalid or unaffordable draft
or recover a lost commit response from recorded request status.
applicable_failure_and_recovery_behavior: return validation errors without execution effects
use request-status recovery for ambiguous delivery
create a new version instead of editing committed history.
expected_unavailable_states: all-fields preflight beyond summary is preview-only
